proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature family
proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which requires activationCost + UseCountResource + resetCadence. Both Defy Death (always-on passive) and Heroic Rally (automatic turn-start trigger, no cost, no use count) cannot be honestly expressed as 'activated' features. A new family is needed for passive/automatic class feature effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Defy Death: 'You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.' (no action, no limit). Heroic Rally: 'At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points...' (automatic, conditioned on state, no activation).

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount — flat_plus_ability_mod variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Rally heals '5 plus your Constitution modifier'. DiceAmount only supports dice-based expressions with static flat bonuses; it has no way to express a dynamic ability modifier addend. A new variant like {kind: 'flat_plus_ability_mod', flat: number, ability: Ability} is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Heroic Rally: 'you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier'

proposed_widenings.name: RollKind — death_saving_throw
proposed_widenings.justification: Defy Death grants Advantage specifically on Death Saving Throws, which are mechanically distinct from ordinary saving throws (no ability modifier, automatic outcomes at 1/20, three-failure death). Current RollKind is 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' with no death-save distinction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Defy Death: 'You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.'

proposed_widenings.name: conditional trigger predicate (Bloodied + HP > 0)
proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Rally fires only when the character is Bloodied (HP ≤ half max) AND has at least 1 HP. No current surface type models a conditional predicate on HP state that gates an automatic effect. This is a new kind of trigger condition not present in any existing family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Heroic Rally: 'if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point'

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_threshold (death save 18–20 → 20)
proposed_widenings.justification: Defy Death's second clause widens the automatic-success threshold on Death Saving Throws from 20 to 18–20. v4 has no atom for 'treat rolls ≥ N as the maximum result' on a specific roll type. This is mechanically distinct from modify_roll_advantage and from the existing crit-window pressure noted in v4 §12.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Defy Death: 'when you roll 18–20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.'

notes: Both sub-features (Defy Death and Heroic Rally) are passive/automatic; neither fits 'activation' without lying about cost and use-count. The heal amount (5 + CON mod) cannot be expressed in DiceAmount. Death saving throws need their own RollKind variant. The 18–20 threshold extension has no v4 atom. This unit forces at least one structural widening (new class feature family) plus several surface/atom widenings.
